name: What size gutters for my home?

mainEntity.name: What size gutters for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: 5" for homes <40' wide; 6" or 7" for larger roofs/heavy rain; calculate roof sq ft x rainfall factor.

description: 5" for homes <40' wide; 6" or 7" for larger roofs/heavy rain; calculate roof sq ft x rainfall factor.
